info.name: NBS Gym CRM lead capture
info.description: The only Apex REST resource in sf-headless-crm. Set baseUrl to the org My Domain and token to a Salesforce access token. Do not add conversion, payment, renewal, merchandise, discount, or refund requests. Those are CRM actions, not URLs. See docs/EPIC-11_D005_API_Documentation.md.

request.description: 201 Lead created on a new email. 409 when that email is already on a Lead. The location name must be an Active Franchise Location in the org.
